asset.name: HumanInputRequest
asset.description: The structured agent request for missing information, a selection, an approval, or a correction, embedding the appropriate control inline and resuming deterministically once answered.

requires.reason: Embedded controls, validation, and submission use the shared form runtime.
Framing and non-colour treatment are shared.
Announcements go through the one shared live region so nothing talks over anything else.

rationale: Determinism on resume is the requirement: an answered request must continue exactly the work that was paused, and a request abandoned or expired must say so rather than silently leaving the run stalled.
